errors.text_span: Секторите са визуално подредени по низходящ размер, започвайки от „Третокласни“ и продължавайки към „Автомагистрали“.
errors.evidence: The sectors are not arranged in descending order of size. For instance, moving clockwise from the largest sector ('Третокласни', 61%), the next sector is the smallest one ('Автомагистрали', 4%), which breaks any descending order.
The description specifies the data is for roads 'в България' (in Bulgaria), but this geographical context is not mentioned anywhere in the chart image itself (title, legend, or labels).
The description does not mention that the pie chart has a 3D visual style.
The description omits that the legend specifies '(в км.)' (in km.) for each road category, even though the chart itself shows percentage values.
